summary: Executed backend pytest smoke suite and frontend Playwright checks against production preview URL. Core public site, auth protection, inventory/POS/quotation/reports/settings flows passed; one minor UI loading-state gap observed in customer detail.

ui_bugs.issue: Page renders interactive shell with temporary default values (₹0 balance, disabled payment button) while customer detail is still loading, which can mislead users and caused flaky automation until explicit data-ready wait was added.

action_items: Add explicit loading guard on customer detail (hide balance/actions until customer payload resolves).
(Code review) Revisit CORS config using allow_credentials=true with wildcard origin in backend/server.py for stricter browser compatibility.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py currently sets allow_origins='*' (default path) while allow_credentials=true; this combo is unsafe/non-compliant in credentialed browser scenarios and should be replaced with explicit origin allowlist.
Customer detail UX should avoid showing fallback financial values before API data hydration to prevent incorrect operator decisions.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all major requested flows passed; one loading-state UX issue)

test_credentials: Checked /app/memory/test_credentials.md first; file contains only template comments, no maintained credential records.
seed_data_creation: Created test entities via app APIs: inquiry records, products, customers, bills (including credit), quotations, stock adjustments, and CSV import test rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Automated backend regression suite added at /app/backend/tests/test_fullstack_smoke.py. Preview environment now includes extra test data and advanced sequences (observed invoice reached AH/2026-27/00013 during UI run). Credit-customer flow works after customer detail finishes loading; add explicit wait/guard in UI.
rca of the issue: Observed payment-modal check initially failed because customer detail view exposes shell UI before async fetch completes. Until hydration, balance defaults to 0 and payment button remains disabled. Once data loads (same record), balance and payment modal work correctly. Mitigation: render skeleton/loader and defer action controls until customer object is resolved.
